title: Sunshine Cottage Nashville
description:
Welcome to our Sunny,  peaceful, and centrally-located home. We have 2 bedrooms 1 bath and a lovely fully fenced-in back yard. 
We are here to help you relax as you work, relocate, or see Nashville in our corporate rental. You may bring your furry friend [dogs only please, we are severely allergic to cats ]. You will have all of the amenities of a home-stocked kitchen full-size washer and dryer and close to everything in Nashville within a few minutes. 
We look forward to hosting your stay!

The space
Living room 
2 bedrooms queen beds 
1 sofa that folds out 
1 full bath 
1 kitchen , stove , fridge , microwave 
Laundry room washer dryer 
fully fenced back yard

Guest access
You will have the home to your self and we rock it old school with keys
